definitions.explanation: A vertical structure that encloses or divides an area.

examples.english: To hang a picture on the wall.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白|しろ}く→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。

examples.english: The wall between our room and the next is thin, so I can hear voices.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかって→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦あきらめない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I hit a wall, I won't give up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}したい→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧。
examples.english: I want to overcome the age barrier and take on new challenges.

notes:
{壁|かべ} refers to a wall or partition in a building, and is widely used figuratively for barriers and obstacles.

LITERAL COLLOCATIONS:
- {壁|かべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掛|か}ける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to hang on a wall
- {壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to paint a wall
- {壁|かべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかる→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧: to bump into a wall
- {壁|かべ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: the walls are thin

FIGURATIVE COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁|かべ}: language barrier
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁|かべ}: emotional barrier
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{壁|かべ}: age barrier
- {壁|かべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to overcome a barrier
- {壁|かべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかる→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧: to hit a wall (face an obstacle)

The figurative sense is extremely common in everyday Japanese, often paired with ⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧ or ⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ to express overcoming challenges.
